title: Storm Sorceress Over Shipwreck
description: A white-haired female elf with pointed ears floats dynamically above a stormy sea, wearing a white and gold outfit while wielding a glowing blue orb staff. Below her, a violent maelstrom swirls around wrecked wooden ships and industrial ruins under a dark, lightning-filled sky with turbulent clouds.
